title: Probe molecular diffusivity in single ternary inorganic–organic microdroplets via interfacial ozonolysis of thiosulfate
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2024, 4,1398-1412
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00072B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tzu-Chiao Hung, Feng-Yu Lin, Shao-Hung Hsu, Toshio Kasai, Yuan-Pin Chang
The aqueous sodium thiosulfate microdroplets mixed with glucose or sucrose are used as model system of ternary inorganic–organic aerosols, and the RH-dependent diffusivity of thiosulfate in such system is probed via its interfacial ozonolysis.
